description: This file contains Swift extension methods for the CronSettings class, providing helpers for job selection, status coloring, schedule summaries, duration formatting, and next run time labels.

classes.name: CronSettings
classes.description: A class or struct representing cron job configuration settings, extended here with helper methods.

methods.name: selectedJob
methods.description: Returns the currently selected CronJob based on the selectedJobId stored in the store.

methods.name: statusTint
methods.description: Returns a Color representing the status string ('ok', 'error', 'skipped') with corresponding color coding.

methods.name: scheduleSummary
methods.description: Provides a human-readable summary of a given CronSchedule instance.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds to a concise string representation.

methods.name: nextRunLabel
methods.description: Generates a label indicating how soon the next scheduled run will occur.
